## Appearance

Harris is described as a dashing young person featuring a huge, drooping pompadour. He also possesses big, rolling brown eyes and an extensive, bewildering smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_
